title: Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to '365 or fewer days, but not 0'
profile_applicability:
•  Level 1 - Domain Controller
•  Level 1 - Member Server

branching.result_aggregation: PASS if the active branch verify step confirms the change took effect; SKIP if a branch step is not applicable to this host (the other role); FAIL if any active branch apply-or-verify step fails; ERROR if role detection fails or neither branch ran. Use the DC verify status for cis_result when is_dc is true; use the Member Server verify status when is_member is true.

objective: Remediate CIS checkpoint 1.1.2: Ensure 'Maximum password age' is set to '365 or fewer days, but not 0'

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: max_password_age_days
parameters.description: Maximum password age in days (must be 365 or fewer, but not 0)

steps.name: Detect server role using command: `(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole`. Expected result: 4 or 5 for Domain…
steps.function: 1. Detect server role using command: `(Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole`. Expected result: 4 or 5 for Domain Controller, 1-3 for Member Server.

steps.name: If Domain Controller, apply maximum password age to 365 days
steps.function: 2. If Domain Controller, apply maximum password age to 365 days using command: `Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy -Identity (Get-ADDomain).DistinguishedName -MaxPasswordAge (New-TimeSpan -Days 365)`. Expected result: policy updated.

steps.name: If Domain Controller, verify maximum password age
steps.function: 3. If Domain Controller, verify maximum password age using command: `Get-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy | Select-Object -ExpandProperty MaxPasswordAge`. Expected result: 365 days.

steps.name: If Member Server, export current security policy
steps.function: 4. If Member Server, export current security policy using command: `secedit /export /cfg C:\secpol.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY`. Expected result: configuration file created.

steps.name: If Member Server, edit C:\secpol.cfg to set 'MaximumPasswordAge = 365'
steps.function: 5. If Member Server, edit C:\secpol.cfg to set 'MaximumPasswordAge = 365' using command: `(Get-Content C:\secpol.cfg) -replace 'MaximumPasswordAge = \d+', 'MaximumPasswordAge = 365' | Set-Content C:\secpol.cfg`. Expected result: file updated.

steps.name: If Member Server, apply modified security policy
steps.function: 6. If Member Server, apply modified security policy using command: `secedit /configure /db C:\Windows\security\local.sdb /cfg C:\secpol.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY /quiet`. Expected result: policy applied.

steps.name: If Member Server, verify maximum password age
steps.function: 7. If Member Server, verify maximum password age using command: `secedit /export /cfg C:\verify.cfg /areas SECURITYPOLICY; Select-String -Path C:\verify.cfg -Pattern 'MaximumPasswordAge'`. Expected result: MaximumPasswordAge = 365.

steps.name: Clean up temporary files
steps.function: 8. Clean up temporary files using command: `Remove-Item C:\secpol.cfg, C:\verify.cfg -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`. Expected result: files removed.

compliance_constraints: This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole, then remediate via the correct path: DC → Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets; Member Server → secedit /export → edit cfg → secedit /configure /areas SECURITYPOLICY. Do NOT use Set-ItemProperty for security policy — it has no effect. Both branches must end with a VERIFY step.
Use failed_when: false on all remediation tasks (except set_fact, debug) so all steps complete and report status

If the remediation targets a specific software/service (e.g., GDM, GNOME, sshd, httpd), FIRST check if it is installed. If NOT installed, SKIP all remediation steps. Do NOT install prerequisite packages.

This checkpoint applies to BOTH Domain Controllers (DomainRole 4/5) AND Member Servers (DomainRole 1-3). Detect the server role first using (Get-WmiObject Win32_ComputerSystem).DomainRole, then remediate via the correct path: DC → Set-ADDefaultDomainPasswordPolicy or GPO cmdlets; Member Server → secedit /export → edit cfg (UTF-16 LE with ReadAllLines/WriteAllLines) → secedit /configure with a FRESH TEMP .sdb under backup_dir (NEVER local.sdb — it is locked by the scesrv service and causes Error 1208). Do NOT use Set-ItemProperty for security policy — it has no effect. Both branches must end with a VERIFY step.
On any failure, report cis_result as ERROR and include the failing step ID and error message in the abort step.
reference_procedure:
To establish the recommended configuration via GP, set the following UI path to 365 or fewer days, but not 0:
Computer Configuration\Policies\Windows Settings\Security Settings\Account
Policies\Password Policy\Maximum password age
